headword: {台所用品|だいどころようひん}

definitions.gloss: kitchenware; kitchen supplies; kitchen utensils and goods
definitions.explanation: A general term for items used in the kitchen, including cooking utensils, pots, pans, cutting boards, and other kitchen tools and supplies.

examples.japanese: {台所用品|だいどころようひん}を{買|か}いに{行|い}った。
この{店|みせ}は{台所用品|だいどころようひん}の{品揃|しなぞろ}えが{豊富|ほうふ}だ。
examples.english: This store has a wide selection of kitchenware.

examples.japanese: {一人暮|ひとりぐ}らしを{始|はじ}めるとき、{最低限|さいていげん}の{台所用品|だいどころようひん}をそろえる{必要|ひつよう}がある。
examples.english: When you start living alone, you need to get at least the basic kitchenware.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of {台所|だいどころ} (kitchen) and {用品|ようひん} (supplies/goods). The suffix ～{用品|ようひん} is productive: {事務用品|じむようひん} (office supplies), {日用品|にちようひん} (daily necessities), {文房具|ぶんぼうぐ}・{学用品|がくようひん} (school supplies).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {台所用品|だいどころようひん}{売|う}り{場|ば} (kitchenware section)
- {台所用品|だいどころようひん}をそろえる (to stock up on kitchenware)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- キッチン{用品|ようひん}: same meaning using the English-derived word for kitchen
- {調理器具|ちょうりきぐ}: cooking utensils/tools — more specifically about tools used for cooking
